evidence: Workbook 'Quality Checks' row 23 (#22, block E) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 23 read via zipfile: 'The verifier Dockerfile ships a pinned browser, Playwright, judge CLI, rewardkit, and the runtime needed to start the app.' Skill references/quality-checks.md:96-98 adds python3 for the restart server and the app's own runtime dependencies; Deterministic Checks rows 11/32 (check-dockerfiles.py, check-runtime-deps-in-both-images.py) applied by hand for context. STATIC: frozen task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd) is byte-identical to the frozen template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty), so it is template-controlled. It provides: the node runtime copied from node:22-bookworm-slim (L1, L4) onto python:3.12-slim (python3 for restart_mcp.py and score.py, stdlib-only imports incl. tomllib); NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (L9-10); npm -g pinned @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 (judge CLI, bin 'claude'), @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (npm view: bin 'playwright-mcp', matching every judge.toml command), express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (L16-22); harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (L31, a published version per pip index); Chromium installed by the MCP package's own nested Playwright CLI (exact dependency playwright/playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05) and symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (L33-39), the --executable-path used by all five judge.toml files; util-linux/procps for setsid/setpriv/kill used by test.sh L104-111 and the restart helper; COPY . /tests (L43), with .dockerignore excluding only Dockerfile, .dockerignore and __pycache__. APP RUNTIME: the golden requires only express and better-sqlite3 plus node builtins (require grep over server.js and src/*.js); solution/app/package.json pins the same versions; the agent image environment/Dockerfile L9-12 (identical to the template) installs the same two globally. test.sh L104-111 launches with env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:... NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, so global modules resolve. The node>=22 engine is satisfied. TOOL FEASIBILITY (Colderwater lessons 7/8/15 bear on tool availability): prompts (functional L15/L29, polish L11/L14/L18, visual L11) rely on browser_run_code_unsafe for independent contexts and single-action timed observations. I unpacked playwright-core 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-05 with npm pack in a private temp dir, without executing it: lib/coreBundle.js defines runCode with capability "core" and name "browser_run_code_unsafe"; the @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 README lists it under Core automation, so the configured args leave it enabled. functional/judge.toml wires restart_mcp.py through /usr/local/bin/python3 with $APP_RESTART_HELPER (exported by test.sh L193); python3 exists at that path in python:3.12-slim. RUNTIME (partial): I re-hashed the raw-evidence-index entries. All 8 artifact hashes match, and all 12 matching_source_files hashes match the frozen solution. via-solve.log reports that solve.sh installed 11 files and all 26 scripted groups passed, including a restart, in image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair. A read-only docker image inspect/history of that image (no container started) shows the same build instructions as the current tests/Dockerfile: apt line, pinned npm -g list, rewardkit==0.1.7, chromium install/symlink, the rewardkit agents.py patch, COPY, chmod and WORKDIR. Its Env includes NODE_PATH and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH. workspace.cjs L6/L299 launches /usr/local/bin/chromium through the MCP package's nested Playwright, and node runs the golden with better-sqlite3 as uid 65534. So the browser, Playwright and the app runtime have been measured working in an image built from these instructions. NOT MEASURED: no full configured verifier run (test.sh -> rewardkit -> claude CLI -> playwright-mcp and the restart MCP with OpenRouter z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx); the index scope says full configured grading is absent. So the launch of the claude CLI and rewardkit, MCP tool exposure through the judge, and judge infrastructure failures (lesson 11, e.g. unrecognized_model) are unexercised. The base images use floating tags: python:3.12-slim now resolves to Debian trixie per the image history, and node:22-bookworm-slim is also a tag. This is template-controlled and outside this row's 'pinned browser' requirement, since the browser is pinned through the exact Playwright dependency. Weak/alternative app probes: an app that needs another npm dependency (for example ws or socket.io for live updates) without installing it into /app/node_modules would fail to start in the verifier image. However, test.sh copies all of /app including node_modules (symlinks confined to /app/node_modules are allowed, L72-83), the agent has public network access to install into /app, and stating that is row 23's concern. The golden needs nothing extra. A broken app gains nothing from the image contents. No defect found for this row.
run_verdict: PARTIAL: browser, Playwright, node and app-runtime contents are confirmed by a scripted golden run in an image built from the same instructions; launching rewardkit, the claude judge CLI and the MCP servers in a full configured grading run is NOT EXERCISED (required runtime evidence missing, hence risk=true).
